actual_hs_list: 841360 (positive-displacement rotary pumps — progressive cavity / screw pumps, all series)
841391 (parts of pumps — rotors, stators, drive arrangements, if supplied separately)
841392 — NOT corroborated: no parts-of-liquid-elevator line found in the product range
product_summary: Official site synopumps.com (sitemap + product pages) shows a single-product-family manufacturer of progressive cavity (screw) pumps: S Series general industrial, W Series wide-throat, F Series food & hygienic, DC Series dosing/metering (0.1–1.0 m3/h, up to 48 bar, up to 120 C, 50,000 cP), BB-W bridge breaker, BBC barrel pumps, W-MAX bio-gas, MP multiphase, X1 grouting pumps, plus special purpose units. Stated applications: waste water/sludge, pulp & paper, sugar & distillery/molasses, food (chawanprash, honey, ketchup), pharma, oil & gas (incl. oil-well dosing, multiphase), chemical/fertilizer, paint/ink/dye, cosmetic, marine bilge, mining, power. Company self-describes as 'manufacturer, supplier and exporter' with 20+ series, 1400 specifications, 50,000 installations. No non-pump product lines (no valves, no complete process skids beyond 'special purpose units') found on the site.
role_hint: manufacturer (self-declared 'manufacturer, supplier and exporter'; no trader/reseller signs found on site — no third-party brands, no multi-brand catalogue). Manufacturing claim itself is заявлено, не подтверждено — no plant/unit address or certification page was retrievable within the call budget.
comment: HS mapping: 841360 is the correct core heading — progressive cavity pumps are rotary positive-displacement pumps (HS 8413.60 covers 'other rotary positive displacement pumps'), so the main line is exact. 841391 (parts of pumps) is plausible/partial: the site sells rotors, stators and drive arrangements as pump components, but no separate parts catalogue or parts SKU list was found, so parts supply is заявлено, не подтверждено. 841392 is wrong/unsupported: HS 8413.92 covers parts of liquid elevators, and nothing in the catalogue relates to liquid elevators — recommend dropping it or replacing with 841391 only. Industry classification 'Нефтегаз и химия' is too narrow: oil & gas and chemical are only 2 of ~25 application segments listed; the dominant segments are waste water, food/beverage, sugar/distillery, pulp & paper and pharma. Recommend re-classifying as 'pumps / general industrial machinery' with oil & gas and chemical as sub-segments. Missing from the declaration: no HS line for the dosing/metering pump range (still 841360, but if supplied with instrumentation/control panels could attract 8537/9026 lines) and no line for pump drive units/gearboxes if sold separately (8483). Per project rule 3, the HS discrepancy is not a rejection ground — company retained, code corrected to 841360 + 841391. All product claims sourced from https://synopumps.com/ and https://synopumps.com/progressive-cavity-pump.html, https://synopumps.com/dosing-pumps-dc-series-.html, https://synopumps.com/sitemap.xml; no customs line was available to me in this task, so every product line above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at shipment level.
